en-US.author: Silhouette America, Inc.
en-US.copyright: © 2026 Silhouette America, Inc. All rights reserved.
en-US.description: Silhouette Studio allows you to access or create designs and send them to a Silhouette cutting machine.
en-US.longDescription: Silhouette Studio is a robust, free design software that gives makers the freedom to imagine, design, and create unique craft projects. With dozens of design tools and easy integration with Silhouette cutting machines, Silhouette Studio is the ultimate tool for crafters who want to make their own unique, personalized projects.
en-US.name: Silhouette Studio
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changes
- Punch marks no longer offset
- Fixed an issue in which ceratin AI files would not open
- Fixed an issue where small cutlines would not be sent to the cutter
- Studio no longer crashes when ungrouping certain store files
- Added the ability to skip firmware updating
- In guided send the connect button now only becomes selectable once a connection has been established
- Firmware  update pop-up now closes at the correct time
- Material no longer resets to cardstock after opening the calibration screem
- 5mm offset no longer exists when using the Cameo 5 Alpha or Plus with an ES mat
- Updated text while updating firmware

zh-CN.longDescription: SSilhouette Studio 是一款功能强大的免费设计软件，赋予创作者自由想象、设计和制作独特手工艺项目的能力。该软件提供数十种设计工具，并能与 Silhouette 切割机无缝衔接，是手工爱好者打造个性化专属作品的终极利器。
